fieldValues.title: Should dreamtime be a standard element of every SRS system, and in what form?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised in Research (Dreamtime), 2026-10-30, as a question to explore before any decision.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. A procedure per repository, as srs-context's dream cycle is today.
- B. One general dream skill, given a repository's purpose and scenarios.
- C. An engine service (a dream command) with pluggable scenarios and a report.
- D. Part of the srs-memory skill only, for project memories.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Which steps of srs-context's dream cycle are specific to a memory and which any repository needs.
fieldValues.next_action: Walk srs-context's dream cycle steps against srs-programme by hand and mark each step general or specific.
